headline: Fisherman's Row Ignites as Heavy Exchanges Shake Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Combat operations have reignited sharply along Fisherman's Row over the past three hours, where four rapid strategic base actions left two positions in neutral ruins alongside seven Colonial holds. Meanwhile, bitter fighting across Stlican Shelf remains fluid with two further base turnovers logged in the last two hours, sustaining a seven-to-two Warden majority under steady attrition. In Weathered Expanse, where base captures had previously stalled, three recent line shifts occurred as two-hour casualty figures exceeded twelve hundred combined. Conversely, the intense skirmishes across Godcrofts have quieted entirely over the last two hours, while Stonecradle settled into a five-to-four Warden edge following earlier contention at World's End. Inland meatgrinders continue unabated in Callahan's Passage, Mooring County, and the Dead Lands, generating high enlistment and casualty tallies even as frontline custody holds steady.
